mapper.select: SELECT region, COUNT(*) as orderCount, SUM(total_amount) as totalAmount FROM biz_sales_order GROUP BY region ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT c.id, c.customer_name, COUNT(o.id) as orderCount, SUM(o.total_amount) as totalAmount FROM biz_customer c LEFT JOIN biz_sales_order o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
